## Method and sessions

Research pass of 2026-08-26, executed by Claude (Fable 5) in Claude Code with
live web access. Sources fall into three classes, tagged on every candidate:

- **supplied** — named in the task brief (jakubkrehel/skills as a structural
  reference) or handed to agents as seeds to re-verify (anthropics/skills).
- **remembered-then-verified** — known before research but opened and
  verified live during this pass.
- **fresh** — discovered through this pass's searches and link-following.

Discovery ran as parallel tracks (one query family per agent), followed by
recursive rounds seeded from leads, then per-candidate inspection at pinned
commit SHAs. Saturation criteria and evidence are recorded below as rounds
complete. Raw evidence: `research/raw/`; inspection manifests:
`research/manifests/`.

## Discovery sessions

### Round 1 - Track T5 (npm ecosystem)
**Date:** 2026-08-26. **Platform:** registry.npmjs.org public search API (JSON, via curl in sandbox), npm package tarballs, github.com / raw.githubusercontent.com for repo verification, WebFetch for HTML pages.

**Method.** Harvested the registry with 7 keyword queries (agent-skill 910, agent-skills 2231 [1000-cap], claude-skill 280, claude-code-skill 99, claude-skills 123, claude-plugin 476, anthropic-skill 6) plus 25 fuzzy text queries (design/ux/a11y/figma/tokens/ux-writing/critique/IA/dark-patterns/microcopy/heuristics/journey-map families). 3359 unique packages harvested; regex filter for design terms x skill terms gave 336 candidates. Because npm descriptions are not verification, I downloaded 84 package tarballs and listed their files: a package counts only if a SKILL.md ships in the installable artifact (or a documented SKILL.src.md compile pattern). Spot-extracted and read 5 SKILL.md files (laws-of-ux, uwayxt/user-research-synthesis, goodux/define, silver/research, ux-ui-agent-skills/design-review) - all real stepwise workflows, not prompt dumps.

**Found: 70 verified candidates.** Standouts: `impeccable` (Paul Bakaus, 62.7k-star repo, Apache-2.0, 23 design commands + antipattern engine); `@uwayxt/agent-skills` (41 product-design skills across strategy, research, IA, a11y, QA); `silver-design-framework` (25-skill design lifecycle with provenance-guarded CLI); `ux-ui-agent-skills` (17 skills, DTCG tokens + WCAG 2.2); `@adobe/design-data-agent-mcp` (official Adobe Spectrum design-data skill); `laws-of-ux` (30 evidence-based principles); accessibility cluster (`ultra11y`, `@ymrl/a11y-check-skills`, `a11y-loop`, `arc-a11y-skills` [UNLICENSED - flag]); content-design cluster (`ux-araby`, `arabic-native-localization`, `@iprithvitharun/dewwrite`); `@ant-design/x-skill` (official Ant Design agentic-UI skills); `@mlllm/ui-ux-agent-skill-system` (21 skills incl. full Figma bridge family).

**Assignment targets.** vercel-labs/skills: MIT CLI, points at skills.sh registry + vercel-labs/agent-skills examples (leads). skills-npm: exists ("install agent skills shipped with your npm packages") - tooling, plus `skills` ("the open agent skills ecosystem") - tooling leads.

**Rejected (18 groups, see JSON):** TS tool packages masquerading as skills (@h4shed/*), platform-gated CLIs (@superdesign/cli - repo 404), flat rule-packs without SKILL.md (dff-skills), manifest-only tarballs (@intentsolutionsio/wondelai-* - content on GitHub, leads), component libraries, marketing/sales/SEO skills, curriculum/database 'design', generic dev-workflow frameworks, oneskill fork spam.

**Could not verify:** @superdesign platform repo (404), mobile-screen-eval's zip-format .skill internals, @humain/ui and analyzthis_design (no repo, not tarball-checked), @intentsolutionsio GitHub content (left to GitHub track).

**New queries generated from findings:** the SKILL.src.md compile pattern (impeccable, @monoes/monodesign) suggests searching GitHub for `SKILL.src.md`; scope patterns @*/skills and *-skill are productive; keyword `agent-skills` has 2231 packages but API caps at 1000 - round 2 should slice it (e.g. keywords:agent-skills+design, +ux, +a11y) or sort by date to reach the tail.
